essence: Trident-lotus emblem bearing four powers; Bhairava all-nature, to be dwelt upon.

sections.SUMMARY: Thus — on will, art, knowledge, power, trident, lotus stayed — Bhairava, all things' own-nature, to be dwelt and weighed.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is peace: stayed, stated, dwelt upon. Closing relished.
